ceo.name: Paulo Ruiz
ceo.background: CEO since June 1, 2025. Previously President & COO (Sep 2024-May 2025), President & COO of Industrial Sector. Before Eaton (joined 2019): 18+ years at Siemens including CEO of Dresser-Rand; prior roles at Fiat. Education: BS Electrical Engineering (FEI, Sao Paulo), MBA (Fundacao Dom Cabral, Brazil), post-MBA (Kellogg/Fundacao Dom Cabral).
ceo.track_record: Led Industrial Sector encompassing Aerospace, Vehicle, e-Mobility, Filtration, and Golf Pride businesses plus Asia-Pacific and Central/South America regions. Previously president of Energy Solutions & Services Americas (Electrical Sector) and Hydraulics Group. Internal promotion after methodical succession planning — named COO Sep 2024, CEO Jun 2025.

predecessor.name: Craig Arnold
predecessor.background: Joined Eaton 2000 from GE (17 years at GE including GE Plastics Greater China, GE Appliances Asia, GE Lighting Services). BS Psychology (Cal State San Bernardino), MBA (Pepperdine). One of six African American Fortune 500 CEOs in 2024. Also serves on P&G board (appointed 2025).
predecessor.track_record_as_ceo: Transformed Eaton from diversified industrial to power management focused company. Drove strategic shift toward electrification, renewable energy, and digital technologies. Oversaw significant revenue growth and margin expansion. Total shareholder return substantially outperformed S&P 500 Industrials during tenure.

cfo.name: Olivier Leonetti
cfo.background: EVP & CFO since February 5, 2024. Previously served on Eaton board (2019-2024). Prior: CFO of Johnson Controls International (2020-2024), CFO of Zebra Technologies, CFO of Western Digital, VP Finance Global Commercial at Amgen, senior finance roles at Dell. Certified Accountant. Education: MS Internal Audit (Graduate School of Management, Marseille), MBA (ESA Grenoble), MS Economics & Accountancy (University of Aix-Marseille).
cfo.departure_planned: April 1, 2026 — announced Nov 20, 2025. Successor search underway (internal + external via executive search firm).
cfo.note: Short CFO tenure (~2 years) and planned departure creates transition risk. Board member since 2019 mitigates institutional knowledge gap.

key_executives.name: Pete Denk
key_executives.title: President & COO, Industrial Sector
key_executives.background: Succeeded Paulo Ruiz. Previously president of Mobility Group. Responsible for Aerospace, Mobility, Filtration, and Golf Pride businesses.
key_executives.note: Key succession bench — next potential CEO candidate.

key_executives.name: Antonio Galvao
key_executives.title: President, Mobility Group
key_executives.background: 38-year Eaton veteran. Previously president, Mobility Group and Corporate, South America. Reports to Pete Denk. Member of senior leadership team.
key_executives.note: Deep institutional knowledge; long tenure signals strong cultural fit.

key_executives.name: Gregory R. Page
key_executives.title: Non-Executive Chairman of the Board
key_executives.background: Retired Chairman & CEO of Cargill (CEO 2007-2013, President 2000-2007). Eaton board member since 2003, lead independent director since 2022. Also serves on boards of Deere & Company (since 2013) and 3M (since 2016). BS Economics (University of North Dakota).
key_executives.note: 22+ years on Eaton board provides deep institutional knowledge. Separation of Chairman and CEO roles is a governance positive.

insider_ownership_notes: Insider ownership at 0.19% is low but typical for large-cap industrials ($100B+ market cap). Institutional ownership ~87%. Board members collectively hold ~$264M in shares. CEO pay ratio 563:1 (FY2024).

ceo_total_2024.name: Craig Arnold
ceo_total_2024.note: Final full year as CEO. 563x median employee pay ratio.

compensation_highlights.compensation_philosophy: Performance-based: significant portion tied to Company, business unit, and individual performance objectives. Peer benchmarking via Compensation and Organization Committee with third-party survey data and proxy advisory firm reports.
compensation_highlights.say_on_pay: Advisory vote on NEO compensation included in 2025 proxy statement.

governance_notes: Board held 5 meetings in 2024 with 98.7% average attendance. Six standing committees: Audit, Compensation & Organization, Executive, Finance, Governance, Innovation & Technology. All non-employee directors are independent. Separation of Chairman/CEO effective June 2025 is a governance improvement. Director candidates subject to Governance Committee review (all independent members). Incorporated in Ireland (tax-efficient domicile).

strengths: Methodical CEO succession planning — 9-month COO transition period demonstrates board discipline
New CEO Paulo Ruiz has deep operational experience across multiple Eaton divisions (Industrial, Electrical, Hydraulics) plus prior Siemens global experience
Board separation of Chairman/CEO roles enhances oversight
Craig Arnold's 9-year tenure delivered transformational pivot to power management with strong TSR
Gregory Page's 22-year board tenure provides continuity during leadership transition
risks: Dual transition risk: New CEO (Jun 2025) + CFO departure (Apr 2026) within 10 months
CFO successor not yet named as of Feb 2026 — creates uncertainty on financial strategy continuity
Olivier Leonetti served only ~2 years as CFO — short tenure limits institutional depth
Low insider ownership (0.19%) reduces skin-in-the-game alignment, though dollar value ($264M board holdings) is substantial
Paulo Ruiz joined Eaton in 2019 — 6 years of tenure is adequate but not deep vs. Arnold's 25 years
